system.effect:
Connection - Weather Ball. The user’s Forme changes depending on the weather. If there are multiple Weather Effects on the field, choose one Forme for the user to be that corresponds with an existing Weather effect. When there is no active weather, the user changes back to their base Forme.
- Sunny Forme in Sun Weather
- Rainy Forme in Rain Weather
- Snowy Forme in Hail Weather
- Dusty Forme in Sand Weather
- Foggy Forme in Fog Weather
- Windy Forme in Wind Weather
- Gloomy Forme in New Moon Weather
- Smoggy Forme in Acid Rain Weather
- Shady Forme in Shadow Sky Weather
- Glowy Forme in Fallout Weather
